note: The vet (`rep`) handler of `orig/g.exe`, `1000:d3a6`..`1000:d6ed`, mapped and ported by the same task (Task 34).  `docs/re/vet.md` is the prose twin and `tools/test_arms_artifacts.py` -- the generic verifier that also covers `data/club_arms.json` and `data/gym_arms.json` -- re-derives every claim here from `orig/g.exe`.  Nothing here reads `src/`, a screen, or Ghidra's decompiled C.
address_forms: `1000:xxxx` is a Ghidra label (Form A of `docs/re/METHODOLOGY.md`) and, because the game's code segment is the load base, its OFF is also the image offset.  `20ae:xxxx` is DGROUP.  `0eed:` and `0f78:` are Form B runtime segments.  A "CS offset" is the image offset of a Pascal shortstring's length byte and the file offset is that plus the `0x18d0`-byte MZ header.

range.note: Half-open.  `1000:d3a6` IS the `rep` verb compare; `1000:d6ed` IS the `girl` verb compare and is NOT decoded here.  `data/command_dispatch.json` is the independent authority on both.

verb.note: The token is read out of the STREET buffer `20ae:3972`, not the vet's own `20ae:3a72`; `data/command_dispatch.json` records the compare at `1000:d3a6` and the token at file `0xB236`.

bounded_on_the_right_by.note: `1000:d6e3`..`1000:d6ed` is `girl`'s own setup and is the last span of the tiling.

discovery_gate.note: The same byte the `i` command list gates its `rep` line on at `1000:eaf7` (`docs/re/club.md`, Part 2), and the same one `1000:6dc3` sets for a brand-new character.

intro_line.text: Ты пришел на ремот, к ветеринару напиши  ^6w^7  чтобы уйти

menu_skip_finding.claim: The healthy predicate is spelled TWICE, and the two spellings are opposite.  `1000:d3d3`..`1000:d3f2` computes it into `al` and branches on `or al,al`; `1000:d4ba`..`1000:d4cf` branches on the three compares directly.  The first decides whether the MENU prints, the second whether the VISIT continues -- so a port that shared one predicate between them would either print the menu to a whole player or never eject one.
menu_skip_finding.note: `1000:d3f4 jmp 0xd4ba` is the healthy-skip: it lands ON the loop top, so a whole player entering the vet sees the intro, then the eject line, and leaves without a prompt.

menu_header.text: ^0Док: не волнуйся всё зарастёт как на собаке

colour_digit.note: `0x34` is `'4'`, `0x30` is `'0'` -- the colour digit the prefix's trailing `^` completes.

menu_lines_note: Both rows are assembled the way every other immediate-priced row in the image is: `0f78:0ae7` (`rtl_str_assign`), `0f78:0c03` (`rtl_char_to_str`), two `0f78:0b66` (`rtl_str_append`) and one `0eed:01c2`.  Names from `data/rtl_names.json`.  Neither row has a district gate; the price test only chooses the colour digit, so no vet row is ever hidden.

loop_top.note: All three branches go to the PROMPT and the EJECT is the fall-through, so the player is thrown out the moment they are whole.  Inverting the sense would eject exactly the players who need the vet.

prompt_call.note: `0eed:0000` is Write, not WriteLn, so the typed line continues the prompt.

case_fold.note: `0eed:0216` lowercases ASCII `A`..`Z` in place and compares against no `0x20`, so vet keys are case-insensitive and whitespace-SENSITIVE.  `Game::shop_turn` trims, which is the standing divergence `docs/re/gaps.md`'s trimmed-prompt entry owns.

loop.note: The back edge targets the LOOP TOP, not the prompt -- the vet is the only handler in this port whose loop re-runs a test before re-prompting.  Nothing between them reprints the menu, and an unrecognised key is silent.

gates.what: jaw set -> straight to the money test
else leg set; neither is SILENT

strings.text: ^0Ого! да тебя не иначе как грузовик откатал!

arms.finding: ONE price clears BOTH breaks.  `1000:d543` takes the jaw case straight past the leg test to `1000:d54c`, so the gate is an OR and a player with two breaks pays 7 once.  A player with NEITHER break is answered with silence: `1000:d54a` jumps to `1000:d5af`, the `h` compare, printing nothing.  There is no 'you are healthy' literal on this path -- that line is the loop top's.

arms.name: тебя залатают

draw.note: The only `Random` site in the range, and the only one in a location handler whose `n` is a bare immediate rather than a district product.  `ax` at `1000:d5fb` and `1000:d61b` is this draw's return value: no instruction between `1000:d5f6` and `1000:d61b` writes `ax` outside the `1000:d600` arm that `1000:d5fe` skips.

strings.text: ^0Щас гайки подтянем и будешь как новый!
^0Так чё тут у нас? Ага, пара швов и всё будет в порядке.

arms.finding: `h` is a HEAL, not a jaw.  `1000:d5de` is `add word [0x38ac],0x5` and neither `20ae:38b0` nor `20ae:38b1` appears anywhere in `1000:d5af`..`1000:d6a3`.  The two menu rows say the same thing -- file `0xB2B2` is `3^7 рубля тебя залатают`, file `0xB2D9` is `7^7 рублей починят переломы` -- but the rows are OUTPUT and the `add` is the flow.  The `Random(3)` picks one of three flavour blocks, all three converge on `1000:d66d`, and only the `0` arm prints two lines.

key_set_note: Four keys, each established at a COMPARE address on the vet's own buffer `20ae:3a72` -- never from a menu string.  Neither key arm sits behind a gate that skips its own compare, unlike the club's `2` and the gym's `3`/`4`/`5`: both preconditions stand AFTER the compare and inside the arm.

exits.claim: TWO exit tokens, not one.  `1000:d6ad` compares the shared `w` (CS `0x848e`, nine push sites image-wide) and `1000:d6be` compares `e` (CS `0x9b6e`, file `0xB43E`) -- the same literal `entry`'s quit verb compares at `1000:edfa`.  Both `jz` to `1000:d6c8`, which `jmp short`s to `1000:d6e3`, the `girl` verb's setup on the STREET buffer, so the street dispatch chain resumes.  `e` at the vet prompt therefore LEAVES THE VET; it cannot quit, because the vet's `ReadLn` fills `20ae:3a72` and `1000:edfa` reads `20ae:3972`.

globals.note: Read once in range, by the gate at `1000:d3b0`.  Four writers image-wide and none of them here.
The `h` arm's subject: `1000:d5de` adds 5 and `1000:d5ef` clamps.  Also read by both health tests and pushed as the first `#` of the health report.
Never written in range -- the vet raises the ceiling for nobody; the gym's `1000:e679`/`1000:e705` do that.
Five writers image-wide and exactly one of them is the vet's, `1000:d558`, in the `r` arm.
Four writers image-wide; the vet's is `1000:d55d`, beside the jaw's, under the same price test.
Debited twice in range, 7 at `1000:d553` and 3 at `1000:d5d9`, and read by the two menu price tests and the two arm price tests.
The shared scratch byte every immediate-priced row in the image writes before assembling itself; 58 writers image-wide, four of them here.

globals_not_memory_operands.note: `20ae:3a72` (the vet's input buffer), `20ae:3ecc` (the `ReadLn` scratch) and `20ae:3972` (the street buffer the verb compare reads) are pushed as DS pointers, never carried as an absolute-memory operand, so they are outside the `globals[]` census by construction.  They are recorded here so the completeness claim on `globals[]` cannot hide them.

known_not_boundaries.note: Addresses this artifact NAMES but does not claim are instruction boundaries reachable from a function entry.  There are none: every address in this file resolves through the aligned decode, which `tools/test_arms_artifacts.py` asserts for the whole artifact.  An empty list is a measurement here, not an omission -- the boundary walk runs over every `1000:` string in the file and this list is what it subtracts.

spans.name: the healthy test that decides whether the menu prints
the LOOP TOP: the same health test, and the eject
the r arm -- fix both fractures
the h arm -- five points of health
the e exit compare and the loop back edge

spans_note: These 16 spans tile `1000:d3a6`..`1000:d6ed` end to end with no gap and no overlap, which `tools/test_arms_artifacts.py` asserts, so a block cannot be dropped from this map by being left out of every span.

sweeps.note: The anchors `tools/test_arms_artifacts.py` asserts SET EQUALITY against, not counts read off this file.  Each is a count over the aligned decode of `1000:d3a6`..`1000:d6ed`.
sweeps.random_call_sites_note: ONE, at `1000:d5f6`, and its `n` is the bare immediate 3 pushed at `1000:d5f2`.  The sweep that says so is the same signature run image-wide and required to find the 86-call population `docs/re/METHODOLOGY.md` records.

branch_census.note: Reproduced from `data/branches.json`'s STORED `port_touched` column at this commit.  That column is a snapshot taken when Ghidra last ran; recomputing the metric the file itself documents (`port_cross_reference.metric`) against a later tree gives a different, larger number, and image-wide the same disagreement is 84 stored against 476 recomputed.  It is structural, not a defect of this range.  `port_touched == false` means 'no address citation', never 'unimplemented'.
branch_census.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
B=json.load(open('data/branches.json'))['branches']
off=lambda a:int(a.split(':')[1],16)
r=[b for b in B if 0xd3a6<=off(b['addr'])<=0xd6ec]
print(len(r),'branches,',sum(1 for b in r if not b['port_touched']),'untouched')
EOF

port_reachability.note: Nothing in this range is BLOCKED on a missing input: every global it touches already has a field in `src/`, it calls into no unported routine, and its one draw goes through `crate::rng::Rng::below_at` like every other.
port_reachability.globals_without_fields_note: `20ae:3b7a` is the colour-digit scratch every priced row writes before assembling itself; `Game::afford` returns the same `'0'`/`'4'` as a value instead of keeping a byte, which is the existing modelling for all 58 of its writers.

what_the_port_must_change.what: `Game::heal_jaw` charged 3 to clear `20ae:38b0` and `Game::heal_leg` charged 7 to clear `20ae:38b1`.  Neither key does that.  `r` (`1000:d537`) clears BOTH breaks at `1000:d558` and `1000:d55d` behind ONE price test at `1000:d54c`, and `h` (`1000:d5b9`) touches no break at all: it is `1000:d5de add word [0x38ac],0x5`.
what_the_port_must_change.falsifiable_as: with both breaks set and 7 rubles, one `r` must clear both and leave 0 rubles; with a break set and hp short, one `h` must raise hp by 5 and leave the break standing.

what_the_port_must_change.what: Both arms fail SILENTLY when their own precondition is unmet -- `1000:d54a jnz 0xd5af` for `r` with no break, `1000:d5cc jmp 0xd6a3` for `h` at full health.  `pay_and_heal` printed `^0Док: вали отсюда ты здоров.` in both cases; that literal (CS `0x9a25`) is pushed at `1000:d4d1`, inside the LOOP TOP, and nowhere else in the range.
what_the_port_must_change.do_not_fix: Do not print a refusal for a key whose precondition fails.  The CS-literal sweep over the range is a set equality and finds no literal for one.

what_the_port_must_change.what: The loop top `1000:d4ba` re-tests health before EVERY prompt and ejects on the fall-through at `1000:d4d1`/`1000:d4ea`.  So healing the last point of damage ends the visit in the same turn, and entering the vet whole prints the intro and the eject line and leaves.
what_the_port_must_change.falsifiable_as: `1000:d3f4` lands on `1000:d4ba`, so a whole player entering the vet must never see the two menu rows and must never reach a prompt.

what_the_port_must_change.what: `e` is a second exit key at `1000:d6be`.  `Game::shop_turn`'s catch-all parses `e` as `Command::Quit`, which matches nothing there, so the vet used to ignore it.
what_the_port_must_change.do_not_fix: `e` here must LEAVE THE VET, not quit the game: `1000:d6c8` reaches `1000:d6e3`, the `girl` verb's setup, and the quit verb's own compare at `1000:edfa` reads a different buffer.

what_the_port_must_change.what: The `h` arm spends one `Random(3)` at `1000:d5f6` on flavour, then always prints `^2Здоровья #/#` at `1000:d683` with hp and hpmax in that order.  A port that elided the draw as cosmetic would desynchronise the RNG stream from the original's.
what_the_port_must_change.falsifiable_as: the draw count inside `1000:d3a6`..`1000:d6ed` is exactly ONE; all three flavour arms converge on `1000:d66d` and the `0` arm is the only one that prints two lines.

what_the_port_must_change.what: The vet's `ReadLn` at `1000:d528` does not trim (`0eed:0216` lowercases only); `Game::shop_turn` trims.
what_the_port_must_change.do_not_fix: Do not fix it here; it is one gap across every submenu.
